description: Use when the user asks about MTA-STS or whether inbound mail is protected against TLS downgrade. Returns the record, the fetched policy, mode, max_age and MX coverage, plus the TLS-RPT record. Ex: 'Is MTA-STS set up for example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
